scope: Independent published SRe2L++ results on CUB-200-2011, FGVC-Aircraft, or Stanford Cars

primary_sources_checked.title: FD2: A Dedicated Framework for Fine-Grained Dataset Distillation
primary_sources_checked.relevance: Reports the target SRe2L++ values on all three datasets.

primary_sources_checked.title: Committee Voting for Dataset Distillation
primary_sources_checked.relevance: Defines SRe2L++ but evaluates it on general-purpose datasets, not the three target fine-grained datasets.

primary_sources_checked.title: Squeeze, Recover and Relabel: Dataset Condensation at ImageNet Scale From A New Perspective
primary_sources_checked.relevance: Defines SRe2L; does not report the target three-dataset SRe2L++ table.

finding: No independent paper with numerical SRe2L++ results on these exact three datasets was located. Exact-value searches resolve to FD2 or secondary summaries of FD2. This is a bounded literature search, not proof that no such result exists.
reproduction_implication: FD2 v1/v2 remains the sole numerical target; independent multi-seed runs in this harness provide the needed reproducibility evidence.
